light.notes: paper is the syntax background hsl(230,1%,98%); bg, chip, and border are derived steps below it (the syntax palette publishes one surface); ink mono-1, mono-2, mono-3; amber and yellow are the two orange hues; series two is cyan. blue is darkened three points of lightness so white ink reads 4.5 on it, and the roles derived from it stay pinned to the published value (MAD-378). The rule takes white on red and mono-1 on green and yellow, at 3.7, 3.5, and 3.6. A fill that reaches 4.5 with either ink is six to nine points of lightness away, a different colour, so the three stay as published

dark.notes: paper is the syntax background hsl(220,13%,18%); bg and chip are the One Dark UI panel steps; border the selection colour, border-hover the gutter; ink mono-1, mono-2, mono-3
